root_cause_criterion.description: The fix adds the bounds check 'i < *naddrttls' to the guard at line 155 of ares_parse_a_reply.c. In the vulnerable version, the guard 'if (naddrttls)' only checks the pointer is non-NULL, allowing the loop to write addrttls[i] for i values exceeding the caller's buffer capacity.

nodes.description: Before the loop, naddrs (6) exceeds the caller's buffer capacity *naddrttls (5).
The write to addrttls[i].ttl when i >= *naddrttls overflows the caller's stack-allocated buffer.

edges.description: The naddrs count from node traversal is used as the for-loop bound.
Loop index i passes through incomplete guard to the addrttls[i] write.
